text:
You need help setting up HubSpot for a small side project so you can send emails, make sales calls, and track deals and dashboard analytics in one place.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d be glad to help you set up a clean HubSpot structure that supports those day-to-day sales activities while also giving you the reporting views you need to stay on top of performance. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, with a strong working background in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets.

A relevant example of my work is the Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture, where I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports. The result was a much simpler reporting process, and monthly close reporting went from 3 days to 4 hours. That project is a good fit for the kind of dashboard clarity you’re looking for in HubSpot.

I also worked on the GA4 migration and tracking plan for Verdant Skincare, where I built a tracking plan and GTM setup to move the shop from Universal Analytics to GA4 before the cut-off. I mapped 46 events and maintained no gap in year-on-year reporting. While that project was on the analytics side, it reflects the same kind of careful setup and reporting thinking that matters when building a reliable system for sales activity and deal tracking.

For your HubSpot setup, I can help structure the basic workflow around emails, sales calls, and deal stages, then organize dashboard views so you can quickly see what’s happening without digging through the system. I’m comfortable working through messy data, setting up reporting logic, and making sure the dashboard supports actual usage rather than just looking polished.

If you’d like, I can help you define the key sales stages, the metrics to track, and the dashboard layout so the setup stays simple and useful for a side project.
